title: scirpus palustris var. mamillatus
intro: Scirpus palustris var. mamillatus, commonly known as wool grass, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Cyperaceae. It is used for its medicinal properties, providing several health benefits such as treating respiratory issues, reducing inflammation, and aiding in digestion. The therapeutic actions of wool grass include its expectorant, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic properties, which help in relieving coughs, soothing the digestive system, and calming muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of wool grass include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
